input.summary: Make MSL's infringement remedies mandatory with a refund backstop and carve MSL's indemnity out of the 3% liability cap, subject to a 3X annual fees super-cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] MSL's IP indemnity is acceptable, but its cure remedies are discretionary and the whole indemnity is swallowed by the 3% bill-of-materials cap. We make procure/modify/replace mandatory with a refund if none is available, and subject the indemnity to a 3X annual fees super-cap instead of the general cap.

ops.oldText: MSL may, at its sole discretion and at its own expense in order to remedy any such infringement for the future, procure any necessary license rights, or make use of non-infringing designs, processes, Parts, deliverables or other materials, so long as such substitute items do not result in the Products failing to comply with the specifications, requirements, and warranties set forth in this Agreement.
ops.newText: MSL shall, at its own expense, in order to remedy any such infringement for the future, procure any necessary license rights, or make use of non-infringing designs, processes, Parts, deliverables or other materials, so long as such substitute items do not result in the Products failing to comply with the specifications, requirements, and warranties set forth in this Agreement, and if none of the foregoing is available, MSL shall refund to IBM the fees paid for the affected Products.

ops.oldText: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
ops.newText: b) Except for MSL's indemnification obligations under Section 15.1, which are limited to three times (3X) the annual fees paid to MSL under this Agreement, the total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
